as_told.title: Ruth Paine takes in Lee Harvey Oswald

plain: In 1963, the year of the Kennedy assassination, a woman named Ruth Paine is said to have taken Lee Harvey Oswald and his wife Marina into her house in Texas. The researcher Peter Levenda tells it on the show: "they're living with Ruth Payne in this house in Texas." Michels brings her up in another episode, linking her by family to a wealthy circle he places around a woman named Mary Bancroft. He describes Paine as someone's daughter "who takes in Lee Harvey Oswald." They tell it because it would put the accused assassin under the roof of a well-connected family.
